camera: Follows Red on the road. In battle it sweeps low as the ring forms, then rises without a cut to a high three-quarter view from Red's side, 55 degrees down, keeping the whole ring, Red and every shadow in view. It never spins; leaves in the way fade.

ui.caption: Both Pokemon's names, levels and draining HP bars, four move icons with emptying cooldown rings, the dodge pip, the swap timer and the Potion count
A bold anime-style caption across the ring reading It's super effective! or It doesn't affect Geodude...
Red winding up a Poke Ball throw, with the red-yellow-green catch meter circling the wild Pokemon
A radial wheel of the six party Pokemon with HP, a runner, flier or crawler body icon, the 30-second swap cooldown and a lock on the active one
A Pokemon learning a fifth move and choosing which of its four current moves to forget, with type and cooldown shown
Oak's Pokedex: seen and caught Pokemon with their number, type, height, body family and the routes where they live
Pikachu's face when Red talks to it, happy, content or grumpy, with its friendship level and the battle ability unlocked
The Town Map of Kanto with towns, routes and Red's position, in flat anime colours
The Viridian Poke Mart counter with Poke Balls at 200 and Potions at 300, and Red's money
A speech box with the speaker's name and Yellow's line, over the scene

music.prompt: Warm acoustic folk: fingerpicked guitar, tin whistle and soft accordion, 84 BPM, a gentle arrangement of the Pokemon Yellow Pallet Town melody, morning at home
Light folk trio: plucked guitar, accordion and glockenspiel, 104 BPM, the Yellow Oak's Lab melody, a room full of new beginnings

Bright road folk band: strummed guitar, tin whistle lead, accordion and upright bass, 116 BPM, the Yellow Route 1 melody with a walking step, written so a drum and fiddle battle layer in the same key and tempo can join it
Cheerful folk: guitar, accordion, tin whistle and hand percussion, 112 BPM, the Yellow Viridian and Pewter town melody, a small town going about its day

Hushed folk: guitar harmonics, low whistle, soft accordion drones and wooden clicks, 96 BPM, the Yellow Viridian Forest melody under dappled green light, written so a drum and fiddle battle layer can join it

The battle layer that joins whichever route theme is playing as a ring forms: driving bodhran and frame drum, foot stomps and a racing fiddle quoting the Yellow wild battle theme, in the same key and tempo so it enters without a cut
Folk band with two fiddles, accordion, bodhran and stomps, 150 BPM, the Yellow trainer battle theme as a fast reel
Swaggering folk: accordion and fiddle trading the Yellow rival melody over strummed guitar and snare, 128 BPM, a smug grin in music
The whole folk band at full tilt: two fiddles, accordion, tin whistle, bodhran, stomps and hand claps, 160 BPM, a heroic reel on the Yellow gym leader theme
A soft accordion waltz on the Yellow Pokemon Centre melody, with brushed guitar and a music box, 90 BPM, warm and sleepy
A bright folk fanfare on the Yellow victory jingle: fiddle, whistle and accordion with a final stomp, 8 seconds

sfx.prompt: Tall grass swishing and parting as something small moves through it
A low rush of wind flattening grass outward, a rising hum as the view lifts, then a drum roll and fiddle pickup as the ring settles and the world dims
A soft shimmer as colour floods back, grass springing upright and birdsong returning as the drums fall away
A quick anime air swish with a faint sparkle for a perfect dodge
A strong double wingbeat and a long whoosh of air as a bird darts sideways
A soft squishy tuck and a quick rustle as a small bug curls up tight
A startled squawk, a flurry of feathers and a light thump on the ground
A heavy, punchy anime impact thump with a short crunch, cut off sharply to match a brief freeze frame
A sharp electric crackle and snap, bright and short
A dull fizzle and a hollow thunk as an attack does nothing
A small soft chime as a move comes off cooldown
A Poke Ball popping open with a red-light zip and a thud as the Pokemon lands
A fizzy aerosol hiss followed by a gentle healing shimmer
A wind-up grunt, a whistle through the air and a metallic snap shut
Three tense clicking wobbles, then a bright ding for a catch or a pop for a break-out
A short cheerful Pika-pi voice cry, playful and bright
A sharp exclamation sting as a trainer notices you
A rising orange hum that builds for three seconds, then a deep boom and a rolling shockwave of rock
A quick bright rising arpeggio, like Yellow's level-up jingle
The music draining to one held accordion note, a slow heartbeat, then silence and a gentle Pokemon Centre chime
A grumpy old man's low harrumph and the creak of him shifting on the ground

style.notes: the original 1990s Pokemon TV anime as approved on 7 Oct 2026 (design/look-anime/targets): hand-painted textured surfaces with drawn ink detail (brick courses, cobbles, stone, wood grain on posts and planks, roof tiles, blade-drawn grass, leafy painted tree crowns), dark ink outlines, hard two-tone cel shadows, and a light and colour grade per area (warm afternoon outdoors, dappled green with sunbeams in forests, cool blue-grey in caves, bright soft light indoors). Painted texture and brushwork are part of the style, not noise; flat untextured fills now read as unfinished. Bright saturated colours, friendly rounded shapes, painted-background skies with white cartoon clouds
